descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Hacksaw Studios is a company that builds online games. Our games can be played both in social gaming and real money modes. We have a wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month all over the world.
We are currently looking for a practical and hands-on Office&IT Support Assistant to join our team in Bucharest. In this role, you will work closely with our IT Specialist, providing basic technical support while also helping with office setup, equipment handling, and day-to-day operational tasks.
We are looking for someone who enjoys solving practical problems, is comfortable working with computers and equipment, and is always ready to lend a hand. Advanced IT knowledge is not required, but a proactive attitude, reliability, and willingness to learn are essential.
We offer a nice office in Bucharest and transparent remuneration (the salary range for this role will be shared with you via email/message prior to the first interview stage).
Please note that we are working full time in the office.
 We Also Offer
23 days of paid holiday per year;
A monthly budget on Benefit Edenred (specific budget details will be provided along with the salary range before the interview).
 Your Tasks Will Include
Providing basic IT support, setting up laptops, monitors, keyboards, and other peripherals, installing common workplace applications, and helping colleagues with simple technical issues.
Connecting, organizing, and managing cables, maintaining tidy workstations, and keeping IT equipment and accessories properly organized.
Assembling desks, chairs, and other office furniture, rearranging workspaces, and assisting with minor office maintenance tasks.
Receiving deliveries, unpacking, carrying, and moving IT equipment, furniture, and office supplies around the office.
Preparing workstations for new employees, assisting with equipment inventory, and ensuring everything is ready for onboarding.
Supporting our IT Specialist with routine tasks, researching equipment and suppliers, and helping with general day-to-day office needs.
 Required Skills
Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with Windows, laptops, and common office applications.
Ability to connect, set up, and handle basic IT equipment and peripherals.
Practical skills and willingness to use basic tools for furniture assembly and office setup.
Comfortable performing hands-on tasks, including moving equipment, assembling furniture, and organizing workspaces.
Proactive, reliable, and solution-oriented attitude.
Good organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to handle different tasks throughout the day.
Good communication skills and a helpful, team-oriented mindset.
Willingness to learn and take on a variety of responsibilities.
 Other Things That Would Be a Plus
Previous experience in IT support, hardware setup, office maintenance, or a similar hands-on role.
Experience assembling office furniture or setting up workstations.
Familiarity with basic Windows troubleshooting and software installation.
Basic knowledge of computer hardware, cables, and connectivity.
